title: Boone County Planning Commission — Site Plan application current source verification
evidenceScope: The preserved Boone County Planning Commission Applications and Forms page links Applications/SitePlan.pdf under the label Site Plan, and that exact official PDF returned HTTP 200 with application/pdf content on 2026-10-01. This establishes current source identity and category availability only. It does not by itself establish when a Site Plan is required, which projects, parcels, or jurisdictions it applies to, every requirement or fee, submission workflow, approval standard, or applicability to a particular sign project. The separately listed Extension of Time of Site Plan form is not this application and is not archived by this evidence record. No sign-project requirement should be inferred from this source without additional current official evidence or staff review.
